Frazier and Sons Medical Group

Dear Colleague,

I had the pleasure of seeing George Patel on May 13, 2025, as part of his ongoing care. I wanted to provide you with a detailed update on his various medical conditions.

Firstly, Mr. Patel's liver transplant from 13.8 years ago continues to be under excellent control. He is currently taking tacrolimus 1 mg as his only medication for this condition. His most recent liver function tests were within normal limits.

Mr. Patel has Barrett's esophagus with low-grade dysplasia, which remains controlled. There are no current medications being taken for this condition.

Regarding his HIV, Mr. Patel has been on antiretroviral therapy for 3.3 years. His viral load has been undetectable for the last 57 months, and his CD4 count is 636. He is currently taking bictegravir-emtricitabine-tenofovir 50/200/25 mg and darunavir-cobicistat 800/150 mg.

Mr. Patel's concussion from 2009 with residual symptoms remains stable. There are no current medications being taken for this condition.

His Crohn's disease, which was diagnosed 0.3 years ago, is currently controlled. He is taking budesonide 3 mg and mesalamine 1.2 g.

Mr. Patel also has cataracts and acne, both of which are under control. He takes minocycline 100 mg and doxycycline 100 mg for his acne and ibuprofen 800 mg and cyclobenzaprine 10 mg for musculoskeletal injuries as needed.

Thank you for your attention to
